title: Pluggable terminology for vp (PreQual, ICD-11)
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 3. Step 2 — Assemble the payload; DVCMinPreQual profile (trust-phw); DVC - Vaccines value set (trust-phw).

statements.label: Pluggable terminology for vp (PreQual, ICD-11)
statements.requirement: vp validation SHALL go through a pluggable TerminologyValidator. A DVCMinPreQual validation profile SHALL require vp to be a WHO PreQual product identifier (required binding). The unconstrained DVCMin profile SHALL accept any code. The library SHOULD bundle the DVC - Vaccines ICD-11 codes as a default validator. It SHALL NOT bundle the PreQual database.

sources.quote: DVCMinPreQual binds vp to the WHO PreQual product identifiers (required binding)
